name: border-width-default
description: At the shipped default. Captures the window with borderWidth at the store's default of 10, so the tinted gap around the web card can be checked for pinching at the corner. The geometry is asserted in AtriumNativeChromeOverlaysBrowserTest.TheGutterStaysConcentricAtEveryOfferedWidth; this scenario exists to put the same three widths in front of a person.

actions.note: the first stream in a run can deliver no frames

assertions.desc: a window was really up when the frame was taken
Cmd+Q still quits cleanly at the default border
